profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at FlexGen Power Systems
profile.summary: Inventive, diligent engineer with skills in network analysis and embedded systems development. Strong education with record of success in circuit design and synthesis.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
• Leading design and implementation of high speed switched-mode power converter controls
    • Establishment of rigorous process of system design, software to hardware-in-the-loop simulation, and hardware  prototype testing shown to be successful for deploying many different products to the field quickly
    • Robust control designs with high power quality implemented necessary for grid-edge applications
    • Commissioning in remote locations installing and verifying 500kW+ power converters

positions.title: Electrical Engineer
positions.description:
• Led implementation of FPGA and real-time controls for switched-mode power converters
    • Facilitated sharing of codebase and documentation for collaboration with wider team
    • Required understanding of DC/AC and DC/DC power converters and advanced linear control theory
    • Implemented designs in use in Air Force contracting, Army, and Border Patrol power systems

positions.title: Master's Thesis
positions.description:
Project: Development of magnetic induction comm. system for wireless underground sensor networks
    • Study and characterization of system based on signal propagation by magnetic flux
    • PCB design and programming of sensor nodes which collect and process environmental data;       
    transmit through digital frequency modulation

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
Project: Design of power supply for electrodynamic screen for self-cleaning solar panels
    • Required strong understanding of voltage multiplying circuits for design
    • Performed PSPICE analysis, PCB layout and testing of power circuit

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description: Used expertise in microcontroller programming to provide a low-cost, low-power solution to addressing cells in a deformable mirror for space applications. Completing project within the power consumption and cost standards for space experimentation under time constraint required dedication and effective communication.

positions.title: Senior Design Project
positions.description:
Project: Internal circuitry for small sensing satellite
    • Designed and laid out digital board for configuration and control of analog sensing board
    • Programmed FPGA for data extraction and transmission; extensive development board testing before     successful FPGA configuration and analog/digital interfacing

publications.title: Ultra-low power multiplexed electronic driver for high resolution deformable mirror systems
